claims.claim: reschedules in seconds / reprograma en segundos / replaneja em segundos
claims.evidence: Live product capability: the rescheduling engine recomputes the plan from current constraints in under 30 seconds. Demonstrable in any live demo session.

claims.claim: Planners go from hours of manual work to seconds / pasan de horas de trabajo manual a segundos / passam de horas de trabalho manual para segundos
claims.evidence: Live product capability: the manual planning step is replaced by the optimizer. The before/after contrast is demonstrable end-to-end in a demo session.

claims.claim: scheduler was spending 3-4 hours a day / programador passava 3-4 horas por dia / programador se aventaba 3-4 horas diarias
claims.evidence: Observed pattern across early pilot plants (multiple customer discovery interviews). The 3-4h range is a representative observed estimate, not a controlled study average.

claims.claim: scheduler was spending half a day reorganizing / programador se aventaba medio día reorganizando / programador passava meio dia reorganizando
claims.evidence: Observed in pilot plants when a rush order triggers a manual plan rebuild. Consistent with the 3-4h/day observation; 'half a day' is the specific replanning event cost.

claims.claim: plant running 200 SKUs across three shifts / planta con 200 SKUs y tres turnos / planta com 200 SKUs e três turnos
claims.evidence: Representative anonymized customer profile observed in pilot engagements. Specific figures (200 SKUs, 3 shifts) are not a single named customer.

claims.claim: 3+ hours a day in alignment meetings / 3+ horas al día en juntas de alineación / 3+ horas por dia em reuniões de alinhamento
claims.evidence: Pattern observed in customer interviews. The '3+' figure is based on self-reported planner estimates in discovery sessions.
